text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me. Could you lend me a pen for 
a moment?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A regular black pen is fine... and, oh my? 
Your wrist has a truly alluring line to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Those deep, smooth lines like a sculpture, 
creating magnificent shadows... Say, could 
it be that you were once on display in an 
art museum?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Even Venus herself would be jealous of 
such lovely smoothness. So graceful, so 
beautiful... One can't help but want to 
take her by the hand.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, please let me take a closer look 
next time. Well then, see you later.
